figurative_meaning_en: The moon during the dark fortnight (waning phase)
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতের আকাশে কালশশী উঠেছে, সবকিছু অন্ধকারময়।
কৃষ্ণপক্ষে কালশশীর আলো খুবই কম হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The dark moon has risen in the night sky, enveloping everything in darkness.
During the waning phase, the light of the dark moon is very faint.
note: This idiom refers to the moon in its waning phase, commonly used in Bengali literature to evoke themes of dimness or melancholy.
